items.title: Bitcoin miners squeezed: hashprice vs hash rate
items.description: Bitcoin hashprice (USD per PH/s per day, 7-day average) against network hash rate since 2019: hash rate keeps climbing while miner revenue per unit of hash stays near its lows.
items.reason: Bitcoin's slide has put miner economics in focus, with analyst estimates of all-in mining cost well above the spot price.

items.title: Average acquisition cost: treasury companies vs. miners
items.description: Average bitcoin acquisition cost of treasury companies, all public companies and public miners, plotted against the BTC price.
items.reason: With bitcoin trading lower, the question is how close the price is to what corporate holders paid.

items.title: How stretched are stocks? S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100: % above/below their 200-day moving average
items.description: How far the S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 sit above or below their 200-day moving averages, weekly since 2019.
items.reason: Tech had one of its worst weeks on record, pulling both indexes back toward their 200-day lines.

items.title: AI capex is eating cash flow: capex as % of operating cash flow (trailing 4Q)
items.description: Capex as a share of operating cash flow (trailing four quarters) for the Big Tech 4, Amazon and Meta.
items.reason: Musk warned of an AI cash crunch next year, and this shows how much of Big Tech's cash flow the build-out already eats.

items.title: Bitcoin Cycle Drawdowns: Peak-to-Trough Recovery Patterns
items.description: Bitcoin's peak-to-trough drawdowns by cycle, by days since each peak, with the current cycle from October 2025 overlaid.
items.reason: Crypto fear hit extreme levels this weekend; this puts the current drawdown next to past cycles.
